submission.bindingBasis: The workspace.close contract compares against an exact expectedSourceStateDigest. The planning-time digest (sha256:e5d8008d...) no longer matches because the owner reports the Workspace source identity advanced after planning (ownerChanged=true). Acting with the stale planning binding would fail not_committed. The correct path per the contract is to re-observe the current exact digest and then close against that.
submission.rationale: The owner action contract states: "a mismatched planning digest fails not_committed" and "after re-observation a caller may close against the new exact current digest". The consequence boundary evidence confirms ownerChanged=true — the source identity advanced after planning, meaning the planning-time digest is stale. The only reliable way to close is to re-observe the workspace to obtain the current exact digest, then close against that. Acting with the stale binding (ACT_WITH_PLANNING_BINDING) would fail not_committed. There is no REPLAY_EXACT available for a digest-based close, and acting unbound would violate the compare-and-close exactness requirement. Re-observation is required.
